verdict.rationale: Twenty offers a Zapier connector for 5,000+ apps and workflow actions (e.g., Slack alerts, HTTP requests) plus a developer app framework that can be published for the community, but there's no evidence of a curated app marketplace where an ops user can simply 'install' prebuilt Slack/helpdesk/marketing/warehouse integrations with a click — most integration work requires building workflows or using external Zapier/CLI tooling.
